title: D32笔记资源加载与预览模块三条审查完成

rules_review.rule1: Resource type/scheme is checked at the loadResource entry only. Completed cache and in-flight set represent different states; repeated requests reuse them. Render completion remains after successful display/reading restore.
rules_review.rule2: Removed the separate blocking document and its forwarding callback. Network completion is a Qt signal handler; no single-use helper extracted.
rules_review.rule3: D32 explicit scope replaces the old blanket denial. Only normal resource success/failure handling, no retry, timeout override, certificate bypass or recovery mechanism added.

validation.network_transport: real local HTTP and TLS; ephemeral certificate trusted on fixture requests only

prior_rounds.cause: Lazy image request was started after the wait; assertion failed and outstanding file request prevented fixture deletion.
CSS fixture omitted the Qt-supported head/type declaration; lazy paint was not allowed to enqueue resources before waiting.
Pixel assertion sampled an x coordinate outside the inline image; replaced with whole-viewport pixel count.

remaining: Actual third-party browser page loading is not part of the mocked link-dispatch test.
Other program modules and unreviewed paths remain; Qt/Mistune internals are not certified by this module review.
